title: Go-Go Town!
description: Go-Go Town! puts you in the role of a hands-on mayor. Build roads, place homes and businesses, optimize logistics, manage workers, attract visitors, and grow a chaotic little town. Nintendo lists both local and online co-op for 1-2 players and a separate Nintendo Switch 2 Edition with enhanced resolution, 60 fps, and enhanced visuals.
